deviations.description: Re-check both PR heads: `gh pr view 10`/`gh pr view 9`, expecting both unmoved
deviations.reason: PR #10's head had moved (new merge commit ada7074dd, no longer draft) since the dispatch premise was recorded. Per the plan's own Scope Hypothesis and Rollback/Contingency, this was reported rather than worked around: reviewed the new commit in a fresh worktree, confirmed the PR's actual diff is still the same three files, confirmed none of the three ruling items were closed by the new wording, and recorded the movement in pr10-review.md's preamble and FOLLOWUP.md's Still open section. pr10-comment.md needed no edit since its asks remain valid.
